title: Secrets of Strixhaven | Episode 1: Penmanship Practice

entities.name: Abigale
entities.description: A deaf owlin Strixhaven second-year poet on field study at the Forum of Amity, who writes to her friends on a scribing board.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A vampire Mage Tower ace and Lorehold student on a trip to the Fields of Strife who fends off a spirit and gets Ajani as an advisor.

entities.name: Sanar
entities.description: A goblin Prismari student at Spectacle Summit who writes very long letters.

entities.name: Tam
entities.description: A gorgon Quandrix student from Shandalar who joins Lluwen on the Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elf from Lorwyn who joins Strixhaven's Witherbloom college and struggles to fit in.

entities.name: Professor Fel
entities.description: A surly Witherbloom professor with harsh teaching methods who leads the expedition to Titan's Grave.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker who becomes Kirol's advisor and cuts down a spirit threatening Lluwen.

entities.name: Oracle Jadzi
entities.description: A smiling oracle who greets the Witherbloom students at Jawdocks Landing and talks with Tam and Lluwen.

entities.name: Jazal
entities.description: Ajani's brother, the only member of his pride who cared for him, who died because he was Ajani's brother.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Kirol met in Lorwyn.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A professor who was tight-lipped about planeswalker abilities.

entities.name: Dean Embrose
entities.description: A dean at Strixhaven noted for being surly.

entities.name: Breeze
entities.description: An owlin classmate of Kirol's on the Fields of Strife trip.

entities.name: Restless spirit
entities.description: A withered warrior spirit in battle-scarred armor with two spears in its chest that attacks Kirol's group, and later Lluwen's.

entities.name: Lumarets
entities.description: Small plant-animal creatures with glowing eyes whom Lluwen finds mapmaking and communicating in Toadstool Copse.

entities.name: Forum of Amity
entities.description: A diplomatic center where Abigale does her field study.

entities.name: Spectacle Summit
entities.description: Sanar's field study site.

entities.name: Fields of Strife
entities.description: A haunted battlefield where Kirol's field study takes place; Camp Herrian is the base camp.

entities.name: Titan's Grave
entities.description: The forest in a titan's remains where Lluwen and Tam study with Witherbloom.

entities.name: Paradox Gardens
entities.description: A Quandrix research site where Tam's other classmates go.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university all five students attend.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: Lluwen's home plane and the site of the group's earlier adventure.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: Tam's home plane.

entities.name: Scribing boards
entities.description: Magical boards through which the friends see each other's handwriting as it is written.

events.summary: Abigale opens the friends' shared scribing-board correspondence from the Forum of Amity.
events.quote: They're coming through to you in my very own handwriting.

events.summary: Sanar writes a twenty-six page letter about Spectacle Summit; Tam asks everyone to keep letters to a page or two.
events.quote: Can we please keep letters to a page or two?

events.summary: Kirol reports that the Fields of Strife are haunted by warriors re-enacting wars and that students must carry a mundane memento.
events.quote: The place is haunted by all kinds of old warriors who are stuck re-enacting old wars

events.summary: Kirol uses a war cry to dissolve a restless spirit that attacked while he carried a caryatid to Camp Herrian.
events.quote: I guess it was pretty good—they dissolved back into the currents.

events.summary: Lluwen writes about feeling isolated among Arcavian elves and plans to join the Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave.
events.quote: There's a Witherbloom trip to Titan's Grave in the works right now.

events.summary: Abigale recalls Professor Fel's poisonous-flora class, which made her drop it.
events.quote: I dropped out of the class that day.

events.summary: Tam recounts meeting Fel at night and decides he is worth working with; she offers to accompany Lluwen.
events.quote: Lluwen, if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

events.summary: Lluwen describes his admission interview with Fel, who stamps his form anyway.
events.quote: But he stamped my form anyway.

events.summary: Ajani becomes Kirol's advisor for the Pranticle Peak expedition.
events.quote: Ajani's stepping in as my advisor!

events.summary: Ajani tells Kirol that trauma awakens a planeswalker's spark and that he lost his brother Jazal.
Lluwen and Tam arrive at Jawdocks Landing in Titan's Grave, where Jadzi and Fel greet the students.
events.quote: Oracle Jadzi was the one who greeted all of us when we arrived at Jawdocks Landing.

events.summary: Tam and Lluwen talk for hours with Jadzi until Fel scolds them for wasting the oracle's time.
events.quote: We spent a few hours talking, just the three of us

events.summary: Lluwen discovers a society of lumarets with a map in Toadstool Copse.
Fel dismisses Lluwen's discovery of the lumarets as not worth studying and threatens community service.
events.quote: They aren't in any of the records because they aren't worth studying,

events.summary: Tam consoles Lluwen and tells him of a frightening encounter with the same spirit, who threw a spear at her group.
events.quote: He hurled a spectral spear at me.

events.summary: Ajani slashes the spear and destroys the spirit with his axe, then tells his charge to be more careful.
events.quote: He slashed the spear in two, and in the same motion brought the flat of his axe down on the spirit's head.

relations.quote: Ajani's stepping in as my advisor!

relations.note: Tam accompanies Lluwen to Titan's Grave.
relations.quote: if it would help you to have company, I don't mind coming along at all.

relations.note: Fel is Lluwen's Witherbloom professor and dismisses his finding.
relations.quote: Either keep surveying and return with something useful

relations.note: They are colleagues who know each other well, with Jadzi calling him Dellian.
Jazal was Ajani's brother, killed because of the relation.
relations.quote: He died simply because he was my brother.
If you ever want to talk about it, I'm here.

rejected.note: Lluwen applied to Witherbloom and was admitted.
rejected.quote: When I submitted my application to Witherbloom
